title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 3
notes: Fresh-main promotion candidate for My Wallet, Tonhub, Eternl, NUFI, and Sequence. Historical Wave 03 queue IDs are not identity authority. Promotion must re-check current canonical identity against latest main. No launch dates are inferred.

events.title: MyTonWallet officially rebranded to My Wallet
events.description: My Wallet announced on 2026-06-17 that MyTonWallet was officially becoming My Wallet, retaining the same product and team while adopting a broader multichain identity after expanding beyond TON.

events.title: Tonhub v2.3.16 added W5 and gasless transfer support
events.description: Tonhub released v2.3.16 on 2024-09-24 with the W5 wallet standard, gasless transfers for popular tokens, mintless-token support, and additional fixes and performance improvements.

events.title: Eternl v2.0.5 introduced the Eternl v2 interface
events.description: Eternl released v2.0.5 on 2025-04-08 as the Eternl v2 milestone with an all-new UI, 30+ languages, MonsterSwap, portfolio overview, multi-signature wallet support, enhanced Ada Handle functionality, and OneKey hardware-wallet support.

events.title: NuFi documented Bitcoin address-type support
events.description: NuFi documented support for Bitcoin accounts using multiple derivation-path categories and Native SegWit, Taproot, and legacy-compatible address formats in its first-party Bitcoin address-types guide.

events.title: Sequence launched a self-custodial wallet recovery app
events.description: Sequence announced on 2024-12-06 the launch of the open-source Sequence Wallet Recovery app, allowing Sequence Universal Wallet users to regain access independently of Sequence infrastructure in supported failure scenarios.

evidence.title: MyTonWallet is becoming My Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement explicitly states MyTonWallet -> My Wallet.

evidence.title: Tonhub v2.3.16
evidence.notes: Official Tonhub repository release documents W5, gasless transfers, and mintless-token support.

evidence.title: What's New in v2?
evidence.notes: First-party Eternl v2 documentation describes the v2 UI, 30+ languages, MonsterSwap, portfolio, multi-sig support, governance, and new dApp browser.

evidence.title: Bitcoin address types
evidence.notes: First-party NuFi guide documents supported Bitcoin derivation-path categories and address formats; event date uses the documented article modification date as discovery basis.

evidence.title: Sequence Wallet Recovery: Complete self-custodial access to Sequence Wallets
evidence.notes: First-party Sequence announcement states the recovery app launched as an open-source, self-custodial tool independent of Sequence infrastructure.
